words.en: A cake is a sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar, and fat.

words.ex: He was born in October.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在十月。
words.en: October is the tenth month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.ex: He put the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: If you put something in a particular place or position, you move it into that place or position.

words.ex: He rowed the boat across the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他划着小船渡过湖面。
words.en: A boat is a small vehicle for travelling on water.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是紫色的。
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.tr:
n. 媒介；方法；
adj. 中等的；适中的；
words.ex: TV is a popular medium for advertising.
words.ex_cn: 电视是一种流行的广告媒介。
words.en: A medium is a method or way of expressing something.

words.ex: He reads a magazine every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读一本杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a type of thin book with large pages and a paper cover which contains articles, photographs, and advertisements, usually on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

words.tr:
adj. 有规律的；经常的；常见的；
n. 常客；
words.ex: He goes for a run every morning, a regular habit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步，这是一个有规律的习惯。
words.en: Something that is regular happens or is done at equal intervals or is consistent in pattern or occurrence.

words.ex: The store is open for hours every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每天开放24小时。
words.en: A period of time equal to a twenty-fourth part of a day and night and divided into 60 minutes.

words.tr: n. 工作日；平日；“weekday”的复数；
words.ex: I go to work on weekdays.
words.ex_cn: 我在工作日去上班。
words.en: The days from Monday to Friday, considered as a group.

words.ex: He got his driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: An official document permitting a person to drive a motor vehicle.

words.tr: n. 介绍信；参考；引用；提及；“reference”的复数；
words.ex: He gave me three references for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他给我提供了三封介绍信用于这份工作。
words.en: References are mentions of something or someone, or the act of looking at something for information.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.ex: He is a friendly boy who smiles at everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个友好的男孩，对每个人都微笑。
words.en: If someone is friendly, they behave in a pleasant, kind way, and like to be with other people.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.tr:
n. 公园；园区；
v. 停放；停车；
words.ex: We walk our dog in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: A park is a large area of land with grass and trees, usually in a town, where people go in order to relax and enjoy themselves. To park a vehicle means to leave it somewhere for a period of time.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.tr: n. 唱歌； adj. 唱歌的； v. “sing”的现在分词；
words.ex: Singing is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 唱歌是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of producing musical sounds with the voice, often in a structured and continuous manner.

words.tr: n. 艺术家；画家；“artist”的复数；
words.ex: The artists painted beautiful pictures.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家们画了美丽的画。
words.en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or a hobby.

words.ex: He reads magazines about sports every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读关于体育的杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a publication with a paper cover which is issued regularly, usually every week or every month, and which contains articles, stories, photographs, and advertisements.

words.tr: n. 电影；薄薄的一层；底片；“film”的复数； v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watch films every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我每个周末都看电影。
words.en: Films are stories or events recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a cinema or on television.

words.ex: The number on the door is 5.
words.ex_cn: 门上的数字是5。
words.en: A number is a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity.

words.ex: He bought new maps for his road trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的公路旅行买了新地图。
words.en: A map is a representation of an area of land or sea showing physical features, cities, roads, etc.

words.tr: n. 男推销员；男售货员；
words.ex: The salesman showed us new phones.
words.ex_cn: 那位男推销员给我们展示了新手机。
words.en: A salesman is a man whose job is to sell things, especially directly to shops or other businesses on behalf of a company.

words.tr: n. 年（year 的复数形式）
words.ex: The building is 200 years old.
words.ex_cn: 这个建筑有200年历史。
words.en: Years is the plural of year, which refers to a period of 365 or 366 days, in the Gregorian calendar, divided into 12 months.

words.tr: phrase. 春季公园；春天时开放或景色宜人的公园
words.ex: We walk in spring park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在春日公园散步。
words.en: A public park or recreational area that features natural springs, often used for leisure activities and relaxation.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.ex: The trains arrive every hour.
words.ex_cn: 火车每小时到达一次。
words.en: To train means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills. It can also refer to a series of connected railway carriages or wagons moved by a locomotive or by integral motors.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents once a month.
words.ex_cn: 他每月去看望一次祖父母。
words.en: Used to describe an event that occurs every month.

words.ex: He joins a book clubs after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后加入了一个读书俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick with a thick end, used as a weapon.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.tr: n. 航海；帆船运动； v. 航行；“sail”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves sailing on the open sea.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱在公海上航海。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving across water in a boat that is propelled by the wind.

words.tr:
adj. 日本的；日本人的；日语的；
n. 日语；日本人；
words.ex: She ate Japanese food for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚餐吃了日本菜。
words.en: Relating to Japan, its people, or their language.

words.ex: He was born in August.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在八月。
words.en: August is the eighth month of the Gregorian calendar, following July and preceding September.

words.ex: He will return next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月回来。
words.en: A month is one of the twelve periods of time that a year is divided into, for example January or February.

words.ex: I eat bread and eggs for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃面包和鸡蛋。
words.en: The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.

words.ex: She dried her hands with clean towels.
words.ex_cn: 她用干净的毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick absorbent cloth or paper used for drying oneself or wiping things dry.

words.ex: I read three books last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周读了三本书。
words.en: A book is a number of pieces of paper, usually with words printed on them, which are fastened together and fixed inside a cover of stronger paper or cardboard.

words.ex: Children love playing games after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢放学后玩游戏。
words.en: Games are activities or sports that involve skill, chance, or endurance on the part of two or more persons who play according to a set of rules, usually for their own amusement or for that of spectators.

words.ex: He uses the internet to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用因特网来查找信息。
words.en: The internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.tr: n. 壳体；贝壳；炮弹；“shell”的复数；
words.ex: The beach was covered with colorful shells.
words.ex_cn: 海滩上铺满了五颜六色的壳体。
words.en: Shells can refer to the hard protective outer case of a mollusk or crustacean, or to the explosive projectiles fired from artillery.

words.ex: Children ride bicycles in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里骑自行车。
words.en: A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet.

words.ex: The painter draws a beautiful house.
words.ex_cn: 这位画家画了一座美丽的房子。
words.en: A painter is someone who paints pictures, or someone whose job is to paint surfaces such as walls and doors.

words.ex: The roads are busy in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上的道路很繁忙。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.ex: I take the bus to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天乘公共汽车去学校。
words.en: A bus is a large motor vehicle which carries passengers from one place to another.

words.tr:
n. 旗；旗帜；信号旗；
v. 用旗标记；
words.ex: The flag waves in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 旗帜在风中飘扬。
words.en: A flag is a piece of cloth with a special design or colors that is used as a symbol, or to give a signal.

words.ex: The dancers practiced every day.
words.ex_cn: 这些舞者每天练习。
words.en: People who dance, especially as a profession or in a performance.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.ex: The children are playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Children are people who are not yet adults, typically those who are under the age of 18.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.tr: phrase. 银行路（通常指以银行命名的道路或通往银行的道路）
words.ex: He walks to school along bank road.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着银行路走去学校。
words.en: A road located along or near a river bank.

words.tr: n. 格林代尔（地名，常见于美国）
words.ex: He works at Greendale Community College.
words.ex_cn: 他在格林代尔社区学院工作。
words.en: A proper noun, typically a place name, such as a street, town, or fictional location.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: The sable is a small animal with soft black fur.
words.ex_cn: 黑貂是一种毛皮柔软的黑色小动物。
words.en: A sable is a small animal with valuable fur, or the fur of this animal used for making expensive clothes.

words.tr: phrase. 北极星；指引方向的事物；指路明灯
words.ex: The sailor used the northern star to find his way.
words.ex_cn: 水手用北极星来找到方向。
words.en: The Northern Star refers to Polaris, the brightest star in the constellation Ursa Minor, which is located nearly at the north celestial pole and thus appears almost stationary in the night sky.

words.tr: adj. 被偷走的； v. 偷；“steal”的过去分词；
words.ex: The stolen bike was found near the park.
words.ex_cn: 那辆被偷的自行车在公园附近找到了。
words.en: Taken without the owner's consent; obtained by theft.

words.tr: n. 夫或妻的兄弟；姐夫；妹夫；连襟；姻兄弟
words.ex: My brother-in-law works at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 我的姐夫/妹夫在医院工作。
words.en: The brother of your husband or wife, or the man who is married to your sister.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.ex: The red flag waved in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 红旗在风中飘扬。
words.en: A red flag is a warning or indicator of a potential problem or danger.

words.ex: The book costs ten pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书售价十英镑。
words.en: A unit of weight equal to 16 ounces (453.592 grams). Also, the basic monetary unit of the UK, equal to 100 pence.

words.ex: He washes his hands with soap.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning, made of a compound of natural oils or fats with sodium hydroxide or another strong alkali, and typically also perfume and coloring.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.ex: Many cities have busy streets and tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 许多城市都有繁忙的街道和高楼。
words.en: A city is a large town.

words.ex: Whales swim in the deep ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲸在深海中游动。
words.en: Whales are large marine mammals that live in the ocean. They are known for their size and are among the largest animals on Earth.

words.ex: The helicopter flew over the city.
words.ex_cn: 直升机飞过了城市。
words.en: A helicopter is a type of aircraft that derives both lift and propulsion from one or more sets of horizontally revolving overhead rotors. It is capable of moving vertically and horizontally, the direction of motion being controlled by the pitch of the rotor blades.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.tr: n. 游泳；游泳运动； v. “swim”的现在分词；
words.ex: Swimming is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 游泳对健康有益。
words.en: the sport or activity of moving through water by moving your arms and legs

words.ex: He plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末踢足球。
words.en: Soccer is a game played between two teams of eleven players who try to score by kicking or heading a ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.tr:
n. 舞蹈；
v. 跳舞；
words.ex: She loves to watch the traditional dance.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢观看传统舞蹈。
words.en: To move your body rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.

words.ex: He hurt his neck while lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他在举重时伤了脖子。
words.en: The part of a person's or animal's body connecting the head to the rest of the body.

words.ex: He twisted his ankle while running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步时扭伤了脚踝。
words.en: The joint between the foot and the leg, in which movement occurs in two planes.

words.ex: He loves boxing and trains every day.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢拳击运动，每天训练。
words.en: Boxing is a sport in which two people fight each other using their fists, usually while wearing padded gloves.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.ex: My boss gives me work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的老板每天早上给我安排工作。
words.en: A boss is a person who is in charge of other people at work and tells them what to do.

words.ex: Sharks live in the deep ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲨鱼生活在深海中。
words.en: Sharks are a group of elasmobranch fish characterized by a cartilaginous skeleton, five to seven gill slits on the sides of the head, and pectoral fins that are not fused to the head.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；赶上；理解；得病；接住；
n. 接住；搭扣；
words.ex: He tried to catch the ball.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住球。
words.en: If you catch something or someone, you manage to get hold of them or stop them from moving, often after a chase or search.

words.ex: The ocean is very big and deep.
words.ex_cn: 海洋非常大且深。
words.en: The vast body of salt water that covers almost three quarters of the earth's surface.

words.ex: The children collected rocks by the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边收集岩石。
words.en: Rocks are large pieces of stone that are found on the ground or in the sea. They can also refer to a type of music that is characterized by a strong beat and simple tunes.

words.tr:
n. 油漆；绘画颜料；
v. 刷油漆；画；
words.ex: The paint on the wall is peeling.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的油漆正在剥落。
words.en: Paint is a coloured liquid that you put onto a surface with a brush in order to protect the surface or to make it look nice, or to produce a picture.

words.ex: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the water cycle.
words.ex_cn: 老师画了一个图表来解释水循环。
words.en: A diagram is a simple drawing which consists mainly of lines and is used, for example, to explain how a machine works.

words.tr: n. 动物园（zoo 的复数形式）
words.ex: Children love visiting zoos to see animals.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢去动物园看动物。
words.en: A zoo is a place where many different species of animals are kept so that people can look at them or study them.

words.tr:
adj. 公众的；
n. 公众；公共场所；
words.ex: The park is open to the public.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对公众开放。
words.en: Relating to or involving people in general, rather than being limited to a particular group of people.

words.ex: The zookeeper brings food at feeding time.
words.ex_cn: 饲养员在喂食时间带来食物。
words.en: The time at which animals or people are given food.

words.ex: The children play outside in hot weather.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在炎热的天气里在外面玩。
words.en: A period of unusually hot weather, especially one that lasts for several days.

words.ex: Water and oil are fluids.
words.ex_cn: 水和油是液体。
words.en: Fluids are substances that flow and take the shape of their container. This includes both liquids and gases.

words.ex: He drank water to help his kidney work better.
words.ex_cn: 他喝水以帮助肾脏更好地工作。
words.en: One of the two organs in your lower back that separate waste products from your blood and make urine.

words.ex: Her kindness helped me when I was sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我不开心时，她的善意帮助了我。
words.en: Kindness is the quality of being gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.tr:
n. 风险；
v. 冒...的危险；
words.ex: He took a risk by starting his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他创业时承担了风险。
words.en: If there is a risk of something unpleasant, there is a possibility that it will happen.

words.tr: adj. 依…而定的；附带条件的；
words.ex: The prize is conditional on winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个奖品取决于是否赢得比赛。
words.en: A conditional action or agreement depends on something else happening or being done.

words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.tr: n. 相互作用；相互影响；互动交流；
words.ex: The interaction between the two chemicals causes a reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质之间的相互作用引起反应。
words.en: An interaction is a situation where two or more people or things communicate with or react to each other.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.tr: adj. 更高的；高等级的；“high”的比较级； adv. 在更高处；“high”的比较级；
words.ex: He got a higher score than his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他比他的朋友得分更高。
words.en: Higher is the comparative form of 'high', meaning at or to a greater level or degree.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: The boy rides a horse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩每天早上骑马。
words.en: A horse is a large animal which people can ride. Some horses are used for pulling ploughs and carts.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.tr:
n. 导游；指南；向导；
v. 指导；指引；
words.ex: The guide showed us the ancient temple.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古庙。
words.en: A guide is someone who shows other people the way to a place in a difficult or unknown region. A guide is also a book that gives you information or instructions to help you do or understand something.

words.ex: The tourists visited ancient temples in India.
words.ex_cn: 游客们参观了印度的古老寺庙。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods, especially in the Buddhist and Hindu religions, or in ancient Greece and Rome.

words.ex: The writers are working on a new book.
words.ex_cn: 这些作家正在写一本新书。
words.en: A writer is a person who writes books, stories, or articles as a job or regular occupation.

words.ex: He values education very much.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视教育。
words.en: Education is the process of teaching and learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this.

words.ex: He told me some myths about the moon.
words.ex_cn: 他给我讲了一些关于月亮的神话。
words.en: Myths are traditional stories, especially concerning the early history of a people or explaining some natural or social phenomenon, and typically involving supernatural beings or events.

words.ex: The servants cleaned the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 仆人们每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A servant is someone who is employed to do household tasks for another person, or to work for someone in a position of authority.

words.tr:
adj. 深的；
adv. 深深地；
n. 深处；
words.ex: The well is deep.
words.ex_cn: 这口井很深。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface; of great vertical extent.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.ex: He reads newspapers every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: Newspapers are publications printed on paper and issued regularly, containing news, articles, advertisements, and other information.

words.tr: n. 平台；站台；月台；“platform”的复数；
words.ex: The company uses online platforms to sell products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用在线平台销售产品。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure or area, often used for public speaking, performances, or as a base for machinery or equipment.

words.ex: Children play in the parks after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在公园里玩耍。
words.en: A park is a large area of land with grass and trees, usually in a town, where people go in order to relax and enjoy themselves.

words.ex: The fans cheered loudly when their favorite singer appeared.
words.ex_cn: 当他们最喜欢的歌手出现时，粉丝们大声欢呼。
words.en: A fan is someone who admires and supports a person, sport, sports team, or entertainment activity.

words.ex: The streets are busy with cars and people.
words.ex_cn: 街道上汽车和行人很多。
words.en: The streets refer to public roads in a city, town, or village, typically with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

words.ex: Tourism brings money to small towns.
words.ex_cn: 旅游业为小镇带来收入。
words.en: Tourism is the business of providing services for people on holiday, for example hotels, restaurants, and trips.

words.ex: The cars are parked near the house.
words.ex_cn: 汽车停在房子附近。
words.en: A car is a motor vehicle with four wheels, usually propelled by an internal combustion engine and designed to carry a small number of passengers.

words.ex: The children explored dark caves with flashlights.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们用手电筒探索了黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or under the ground. If something caves, it falls inward or collapses.

words.ex: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用灌溉来浇灌庄稼。
words.en: Irrigation is the process of supplying water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.ex: The tree grows near the house.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树长在房子旁边。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant with a trunk and branches made of wood.

words.ex: Ducks swim in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A pond is a small area of water that is smaller than a lake, often artificially created.

words.ex: Farmers work hard in agriculture.
words.ex_cn: 农民在农业中辛勤工作。
words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.tr: n. 信号；“signal”的复数； v. 预示；
words.ex: The radio receives signals from satellites.
words.ex_cn: 收音机接收来自卫星的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.tr:
adj. 人的；人类的；
n. 人；人类；
words.ex: Human emotions are complex and powerful.
words.ex_cn: 人的情感复杂而强大。
words.en: A human is a member of the species Homo sapiens, distinguished from other animals by superior mental development, power of articulate speech, and upright stance.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了头。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.ex: The helicopter flew over the city.
words.ex_cn: 直升机飞过了城市。
words.en: A helicopter is a type of aircraft that derives both lift and propulsion from one or more sets of horizontally revolving overhead rotors. It is capable of moving vertically and horizontally, the direction of motion being controlled by the pitch of the rotor blades.

words.tr:
adj. 直接的；
v. 指导；指示；
words.ex: He gave a direct answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了直接的答案。
words.en: If you direct something at a particular thing, you aim or point it at that thing.

words.tr: v. 导航；应付（复杂情况）；
words.ex: He uses a map to navigate the city.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图来导航这座城市。
words.en: To navigate is to plan and direct the route or course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments or maps.

words.ex: The birds fly high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在天空中高飞。
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.ex: The children built a castle in the sand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在沙子里建了一座城堡。
words.en: Sand is a substance that consists of very small grains of rock, found on beaches and in deserts.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 劳动；体力劳动；劳工；
words.ex: Hard labor helps build strong character.
words.ex_cn: 辛勤的劳动有助于培养坚强的品格。
words.en: Work, especially physical work; to work hard.

words.ex: His strength helped him lift the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他的力量让他举起了那个重箱子。
words.en: The quality or state of being physically strong.

words.tr: adj. 受保护的； v. 保护；“protect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The protected forest is home to many rare animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个受保护的森林是许多稀有动物的家园。
words.en: If something is protected, it is kept safe from harm or damage.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: The team created a mapping of the forest area.
words.ex_cn: 团队制作了该森林区域的制图。
words.en: The process of making a map or the representation of the structure of something.

words.ex: Social media trends change quickly.
words.ex_cn: 社交媒体的趋势变化很快。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: The survival of the animals depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物的生存取决于天气。
words.en: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of an accident, ordeal, or difficult circumstances.

words.ex: The frequency of the radio station is 101.5 MHz.
words.ex_cn: 这个电台的频率是101.5兆赫。
words.en: The rate at which something happens or is repeated over a particular period of time.

words.tr: n. 录音；录制； v. 记录；录制；“record”的现在分词；
words.ex: I listened to the recording of the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我听了讲座的录音。
words.en: A recording is a piece of music or speech that has been recorded, or the process of making such a record.

words.ex: He wrote three short essays about his travels.
words.ex_cn: 他写了三篇关于他旅行的短随笔。
words.en: A short piece of writing on a particular subject, often expressing personal views.

words.ex: His painting shows great originality.
words.ex_cn: 他的画作展现了极大的独创性。
words.en: The quality of being new and original in a way that is not derived from something else.

words.ex: There was silence after the bad news.
words.ex_cn: 坏消息传来后，一片沉默。
words.en: The absence of sound; complete quiet.

words.ex: His nature is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的本性是善良且有耐心的。
words.en: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people, including plants, animals, mountains, oceans, stars, etc. It can also refer to the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.

words.ex: He was a pioneer in space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 他是太空探索的先驱者。
words.en: A pioneer is someone who is one of the first people to do something that others will later develop or continue. Pioneers are also people who are among the first to go to live in a new area, especially in the past when people were trying to settle in new lands.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: He is my friend.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的朋友。
words.en: A friend is someone who you know well and like, but who is not related to you.

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.ex: He found a piece of metal in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里发现了一块金属。
words.en: Metal is a hard, shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr:
adj. 干的；
v. 变干；
words.ex: The cloth is dry after the sun.
words.ex_cn: 这块布在阳光下晒干了。
words.en: If something is dry, there is no water or moisture on it or in it.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.ex: The pirates stole gold from the ship.
words.ex_cn: 海盗从船上偷了黄金。
words.en: Pirates are people who attack and rob ships at sea.

words.ex: He felt hunger after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一个小时后感到饥饿。
words.en: A strong desire or need for food.

words.ex: He sells apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上卖苹果。
words.en: To give or hand over (something) in exchange for money.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.ex: The government provides free education.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供免费教育。
words.en: The group of people who officially control a country or the system used for controlling a country.

words.ex: Many diseases can be prevented with clean water.
words.ex_cn: 许多疾病可以通过干净的水来预防。
words.en: A disease is an illness which affects people, animals, or plants, for example one which is caused by bacteria or infection.

words.ex: She plants flowers in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种花。
words.en: A garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass.

words.ex: Humans need water to survive.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要水来生存。
words.en: Human beings collectively; the human race.

words.ex: He bought timber to build a fence.
words.ex_cn: 他买了木材来建篱笆。
words.en: Wood prepared for use in building and carpentry.

words.ex: He lives in Russia.
words.ex_cn: 他住在俄罗斯。
words.en: A country in Eastern Europe and Northern Asia, known for its vast territory and rich history.

words.tr: n. 面巾纸；手巾纸；“tissue”的复数；
words.ex: She wiped her nose with a tissue.
words.ex_cn: 她用一张面巾纸擦了鼻子。
words.en: A tissue is a piece of soft thin paper which is used for wiping, especially for wiping the nose. In biology, tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to do a particular job.

words.ex: He bought three pairs of shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他买了三双鞋。
words.en: Two things of the same type that are used together or regarded as a unit.

words.ex: Birds begin migration in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在秋天开始迁徙。
words.en: The movement of people, animals, or birds from one place to another, especially regularly according to the seasons.

words.ex: The digestive system breaks down food.
words.ex_cn: 消化系统分解食物。
words.en: Relating to the process of digesting food.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.ex_cn: 这两个苹果不一样。
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃肉。
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.ex: The kettle produces steam when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生蒸汽。
words.en: Steam is the hot mist that forms when water boils. It can be used to power machines or to cook food.

words.tr:
n. 税；税款；
v. 对...征税；
words.ex: He pays tax every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年缴税。
words.en: A tax is a sum of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services.

words.ex: Children love to watch insects in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在花园里观察昆虫。
words.en: Insects are small creatures such as flies, ants, and bees that have six legs, a body divided into three parts, and often one or two pairs of wings.

words.ex: She eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Someone who is healthy is well and is not suffering from any illness.

words.tr:
v. 玩；扮演；演奏；播放；
n. 戏剧；比赛；
words.ex: The children play in the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在公园里玩。
words.en: When children, animals, or perhaps adults play, they spend time doing enjoyable things, such as using toys and taking part in games. When you play a sport, game, or match, you take part in it. Play is also a noun referring to a dramatic work or performance.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.ex: His contribution helped the team win.
words.ex_cn: 他的贡献帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A contribution is a gift or payment to a common fund or collection, or the part played by a person or thing in bringing about a result or helping something to advance.

words.ex: His tolerance for different opinions is impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他对不同观点的宽容令人印象深刻。
words.en: The ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behaviour that one dislikes or disagrees with.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.ex: He finds peace through spiritual meditation.
words.ex_cn: 他通过精神上的冥想找到平静。
words.en: Relating to the human spirit or soul as opposed to material or physical things.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.ex: The child has two strong legs.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子有两条强壮的腿。
words.en: Legs are the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.ex: He eats nuts every morning for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃坚果当早餐。
words.en: If you say that someone is nuts, you mean that they are crazy. Nuts are hard-shelled fruits of some trees.

words.ex: The sun burned his skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳晒伤了他的皮肤。
words.en: Your skin is the natural outer covering of your body.

words.tr: n. 烹饪； adj. 烹调用的； v. 烹饪；“cook”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cooking is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 烹饪是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of preparing food by heating it.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.tr:
n. 烟；烟雾；
v. 抽烟；冒烟；
words.ex: The fire produced thick smoke.
words.ex_cn: 火灾产生了浓烟。
words.en: Smoke consists of gas and small bits of solid material that are sent into the air when something burns.

words.ex: The garden is full of bright flowers.
words.ex_cn: 花园里开满了鲜艳的花。
words.en: A flower is the part of a plant which is often brightly colored, grows at the end of a stem, and only survives for a short time.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: Scientists found fossils in the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在岩石中发现了化石。
words.en: Fossils are the remains or impressions of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.tr: n. 无线电；无线电广播；收音机；
words.ex: He listens to the radio every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听无线电。
words.en: A radio is the equipment that you use to listen to broadcasts of news, music, and other programs.

words.ex: The first century had no computers.
words.ex_cn: 第一个世纪没有电脑。
words.en: A century is a period of one hundred years.

words.ex: Many people take subways to work in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在大城市里乘地铁上班。
words.en: A subway is an underground railway system in a city.

words.tr: n. 故事；小说；轶事；假话；
words.ex: He told a funny story to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A story is a description of imaginary people and events, which is written or told in order to entertain.

words.ex: The train went through a long tunnel.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过了一条长长的隧道。
words.en: A tunnel is a long passage which has been made under or through the ground, usually through a hill or under a river, to allow people or vehicles to travel through it.

words.ex: The cat sat on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在屋顶上。
words.en: The roof of a building is the covering on top of it that protects the people and things inside from the weather.

words.tr:
n. 火；
v. 射击；开火；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 火在壁炉里熊熊燃烧。
words.en: Fire is the heat and light that comes out when something burns. It can also refer to the act of shooting a weapon or the dismissal of an employee from a job.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.tr: n. 洪水泛滥； v. 淹没；“flood”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused flooding in the city.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了城市洪水泛滥。
words.en: Flooding refers to the overflow of water onto land that is normally dry, often caused by heavy rainfall, melting snow, or the failure of dams or levees.

words.tr: phrase. 一般水平；普遍程度
words.ex: His math skills are at a general level.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学水平是一般水平。
words.en: The average or standard condition, quality, or achievement within a particular group or context.

words.ex: The genetic feature makes the plant grow faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个遗传特征使植物生长得更快。
words.en: A characteristic of an organism determined by its genetic makeup.

words.ex: The temperature remains constant during the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 实验过程中温度保持不变。
words.en: Stays the same; does not change over time or under different conditions.

words.ex: She enjoys simple life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢乡村里的简单生活。
words.en: Life is the existence of an individual human being or animal.

words.tr: phrase. 遗传起源；基因来源
words.ex: The boy's genetic origin is from China.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩的遗传起源来自中国。
words.en: The genetic origin refers to the initial source or cause of genetic traits or conditions, tracing back to the DNA or hereditary factors.

words.ex: Scientists conduct studies of twins to understand genetics.
words.ex_cn: 科学家进行双胞胎研究以了解遗传学。
words.en: Scientific research that compares identical and fraternal twins to study the influence of genetics and environment on traits and behaviors.

words.tr: phrase. 显著的相似性；相当大的相似之处
words.ex: There is considerable similarity between the two paintings.
words.ex_cn: 这两幅画之间有显著的相似性。
words.en: A noticeable and significant likeness or resemblance.

words.tr: phrase. 环境起源；源于环境的来源
words.ex: The pollution has an environmental origin.
words.ex_cn: 这种污染具有环境起源。
words.en: The source or cause of something related to the natural world or surroundings.

words.ex: They shared similar experiences in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着相似的高中经历。
words.en: Shared events or situations that are alike in nature or effect.

words.ex: He learned to cook food from another culture.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了另一种文化的烹饪。
words.en: A different society or community with its own customs, beliefs, and practices.

words.tr: phrase. 显著的改进；重大的提升
words.ex: He showed a significant improvement in his math test.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学考试取得了显著进步。
words.en: A significant improvement is a change or development that makes something much better than it was before.

words.tr: phrase. 多元智能（指人类智能的多种不同类型，如语言智能、逻辑数学智能、空间智能等）
words.ex: He believes children have multiple intelligences.
words.ex_cn: 他相信孩子拥有多种智力。
words.en: A theory proposing that individuals possess various distinct types of intelligence, such as linguistic, logical-mathematical, and interpersonal, rather than a single general intelligence.

words.tr: phrase. 分离的智能；独立的智慧体
words.ex: Each child has separate intelligences for math, music, and sports.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子在数学、音乐和运动方面都有独立的智能。
words.en: Distinct and independent mental faculties or types of intelligence.

words.ex: He is interested in linguistic patterns in children.
words.ex_cn: 他对儿童的语言模式感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to language or linguistics.

words.tr: phrase. 逻辑能力；逻辑技能
words.ex: He improved his logical skill by solving puzzles every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天解谜题来提高自己的逻辑能力。

words.tr: phrase. 音乐才能；音乐能力
words.ex: He showed great musical abilities at a young age.
words.ex_cn: 他在很小的时候就展现了出色的音乐才能。
words.en: Natural aptitudes or talents related to music, such as playing an instrument or singing.

words.tr: phrase. 认知能力；指个体感知、记忆、思维、判断和解决问题等心理过程的能力
words.ex: Children develop cognitive abilities as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在成长过程中发展认知能力。
words.en: Cognitive abilities refer to the mental skills that we use to perform any task, from the simplest to the most complex. They are linked with the mechanisms of how we learn, remember, problem-solve, and pay attention.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.ex: The rhythm of the music made everyone dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐的节奏让所有人都跳起了舞。
words.en: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

words.tr: n. 拼写；拼法； v. “spell”的现在分词；
words.ex: His spelling is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 他的拼写很差。
words.en: The forming of words from letters according to accepted usage; orthography.

words.ex: The factory makes cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A factory is a large building where machines are used to make goods in large quantities.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.ex: The children play on the grass after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在草地上玩耍。
words.en: Grass is a very common plant consisting of large numbers of thin, spiky, green leaves that cover the surface of the ground.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.tr:
v. 给…打电话；响铃；
n. 环；环形物；铃声；拳击场；
words.ex: I will ring you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天给你打电话。
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. It can also refer to the act of making a clear resonant or vibrating sound, or to encircle or surround something.

words.tr:
adj. 高的；
adv. 在高处；
words.ex: The mountain is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这座山很高。
words.en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a particular point.

words.ex: This box is smaller than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子比那个更小。
words.en: Smaller is the comparative form of small, meaning more little in size, amount, degree, or importance.

words.tr:
n. 烟；烟雾；
v. 抽烟；冒烟；
words.ex: The fire produced thick smoke.
words.ex_cn: 火灾产生了浓烟。
words.en: Smoke consists of gas and small bits of solid material that are sent into the air when something burns.

words.ex: Elephants live in groups called herds.
words.ex_cn: 大象生活在称为象群的群体中。
words.en: Elephants are large mammals of the family Elephantidae and the order Proboscidea. Two species are traditionally recognized, the African elephant and the Asian elephant.

words.ex: He carries water in buckets.
words.ex_cn: 他用桶提水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other materials.

words.ex: The children ride horses in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里骑马。
words.en: Horses are large animals with four legs, a mane, and a tail, which people ride or use to pull vehicles or carry loads.

words.ex: I love swimming in the sea during summer.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在夏天去海里游泳。
words.en: Summer is the season between spring and autumn when the weather is usually warm or hot.

words.tr: n. 农事；耕作；养殖； v. 务农；“farm”的现在分词；
words.ex: Farming is hard work in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 农事在乡村是很辛苦的工作。
words.en: Farming is the activity of growing crops or keeping animals on a farm.

words.tr: n. 单词；字；话语；“word”的复数；
words.ex: He learned new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天学习新单词。
words.en: Words are the basic units of language used to communicate ideas.

words.tr: n. 意思；意义； v. 表示…的意思；意思；“mean”的现在分词；
words.ex: What is the meaning of this word?
words.ex_cn: 这个词的意思是什么？
words.en: The meaning of something is what it expresses or represents.

words.ex: He gave an emotional speech about his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于他母亲的感人演讲。
words.en: Something that is emotional is connected with people's feelings. If someone is emotional, they show their feelings very openly, especially because they are upset.

words.tr: n. 梦想；美梦；梦想，美梦（dream 的复数形式）；
words.ex: He works hard to make his dreams come true.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的梦想。
words.en: Dreams are a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. They can also refer to cherished aspirations, ambitions, or ideals.

words.ex: Many children live in rural areas far from cities.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子住在远离城市的农村地区。
words.en: Rural areas are regions located outside towns and cities, often characterized by a lower population density and a focus on agricultural activities.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.ex: The boy picked up a stone from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块石头。
words.en: A stone is a small piece of rock that is found on the ground.

words.tr: n. 眼镜；玻璃杯；“glass”的复数；
words.ex: He wears glasses to see the board clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴眼镜以便清楚地看到黑板。
words.en: Glasses are objects worn in front of the eyes to help people see better. They consist of a pair of lenses set in a frame that rests on the nose and ears.

words.ex: Last month's rainfall was very low.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的降雨量非常少。
words.en: Rainfall is the amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a particular period.

words.ex: The house is built with wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是用木材建造的。
words.en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees. It is used for building and making things.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.ex: Follow the guidelines to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 遵循指南以通过考试。
words.en: Guidelines are general rules, principles, or pieces of advice that help you to do something or to decide what to do in a particular situation.

words.ex: He votes in a democratic election.
words.ex_cn: 他在民主选举中投票。
words.en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: The government increased transparency about its decisions.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了决策的透明度。
words.en: The condition of being transparent, especially in a way that allows easy understanding or recognition of something.

words.tr: phrase. 员工优先的；以员工为先的
words.ex: The company has an employee first policy.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司秉持员工优先的政策。
words.en: A company policy or philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and needs of its employees.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.ex: The lake is covered with ice in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天湖面结满了冰。
words.en: Ice is frozen water. It is a solid state of water that occurs when water freezes at or below 0 degrees Celsius.

words.ex: The children love to see animals at the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在动物园看动物。
words.en: Animals are living creatures such as dogs, lions, and dolphins. They are not plants, and they can usually move around and react to their surroundings.

words.ex: He brushed his teeth every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刷牙。
words.en: The hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: Resources are materials, money, and other assets that can be used to function effectively.

words.ex: The soldiers carried weapons to protect the village.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们携带武器保护村庄。
words.en: Weapons are objects designed to be used in fighting or war, such as guns, bombs, knives, etc.

words.ex: The boats are floating on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 船在湖上漂浮。
words.en: A boat is a vehicle for travelling on water, especially one that is small enough to be carried on a ship or to float on a river or lake.

words.ex: The fish swim among the seaweed near the shore.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在岸边的海藻间游动。
words.en: Seaweed is a plant that grows in the sea, especially in the ocean. It is often used in food, medicine, and cosmetics.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.ex: The ship uses navigational tools to find its way.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用航行工具来确定方向。
words.en: Relating to the process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.tr:
adj. 净余的；
n. 网；
words.ex: The net profit after taxes is $500.
words.ex_cn: 缴税后的净收益是500美元。
words.en: A net is a piece of thin fabric or thread that is used to catch fish, insects, or other small animals. It can also refer to the amount of money remaining after all expenses have been deducted.

words.ex: The bodies floated in the river.
words.ex_cn: 这些尸体漂浮在河上。
words.en: The physical structure of a person or an animal, including the bones, flesh, and organs.

words.tr:
v. 微笑；
n. 微笑；
words.ex: I smile every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天微笑。
words.en: A smile is the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or amused, or when you are being friendly. When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth.

words.tr: n. 步行； v. 步行；行走；“walk”的现在分词； adj. 步行的；
words.ex: Walking is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 步行对健康有益。
words.en: Walking is the activity of going for a walk, especially for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: He writes a letter every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写一封信。
words.en: To write means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.tr: n. 植物；发电厂；工厂；作物；“plant”的复数；
words.ex: Plants need sunlight and water to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要阳光和水来生长。
words.en: Plants are living organisms that typically grow in soil and have leaves, stems, and roots. They are essential for the environment as they produce oxygen and provide food for many animals.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.ex: He lost sight of the bird flying away.
words.ex_cn: 他看不见那只飞走的鸟了。
words.en: The ability to see; the act of seeing or the thing seen.

words.ex: He gave a short speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一个简短的讲话。
words.en: Speech is the expression of or the ability to express thoughts and feelings by articulate sounds.

words.ex: The children played in the natural park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自然公园里玩耍。
words.en: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.ex: We wrote the dates on the calendar.
words.ex_cn: 我们把日期写在日历上。
words.en: Particular days of the month or year, often specified for events, meetings, or deadlines.

words.ex: The journalist wrote a story about the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 记者写了一篇关于地震的文章。
words.en: A journalist is a person whose job is to collect news and write about it for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio.

words.tr: n. 母亲；根源（mother 的复数）；
words.ex: Mothers love their children deeply.
words.ex_cn: 母亲们深爱着自己的孩子。
words.en: A mother is a female parent of a child. Mothers are women who inhabit or perform the role of bearing some relation to their children, who may or may not be their biological offspring.

words.ex: The cake has three layers.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层。
words.en: Layers refer to sheets, quantities, or thicknesses of material, typically one of several, covering a surface or body. It can also refer to a person or thing that lays something, especially in a particular way.

words.ex: He tied the box with a strong rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根结实的绳子把箱子绑了起来。
words.en: A rope is a thick cord made by twisting together strands of natural fibers such as hemp or artificial fibers such as nylon.

words.ex: The rain fell all night.
words.ex_cn: 雨下了一整夜。
words.en: Rain is water that falls from the clouds in small drops.

words.ex: The dog buried the bones in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 狗把骨头埋在了院子里。
words.en: The hard parts inside a human or animal that make up its skeleton.

words.tr:
v. 行走；
n. 步行；
words.ex: I walk to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天步行去学校。
words.en: To move along on foot at a moderate pace; to go on foot for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: There is danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 河边有危险。
words.en: Danger is the possibility that someone may be harmed or killed.

words.tr: adj. 野生的；狂热的；荒芜的；猛烈的；
words.ex: The lion is a wild animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种野生动物。
words.en: Living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.

words.tr: adj. 敏感的；感情脆弱的；体贴的；善解人意的；
words.ex: He is sensitive to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对大声响很敏感。
words.en: If you are sensitive to other people's needs, problems, or feelings, you understand and are aware of them.

words.ex: He reads the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

words.ex: He blew a whistle to get our attention.
words.ex_cn: 他吹了一声口哨来引起我们的注意。
words.en: A whistle is a small metal tube which you blow in order to produce a loud sound and attract someone's attention. A whistle is also the sound that you make when you blow a whistle or when you whistle.

words.tr:
v. 打架；战斗；
n. 打架；战斗；
words.ex: The two boys fight every day after school.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天放学后都打架。
words.en: To fight means to take part in a violent struggle involving the exchange of physical blows or the use of weapons. It can also refer to a determined effort to achieve or resist something.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.ex: The study uses a new methodology to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究使用了一种新的方法论来收集数据。
words.en: A methodology is a system of methods and principles for doing something, for example for teaching or for carrying out research.

words.tr:
n. 笑话；玩笑；
v. 开玩笑；
words.ex: He told a funny joke at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上讲了一个有趣的笑话。
words.en: A joke is something that is said or done to make people laugh, especially a funny story or a trick played on someone.

words.ex: Females are more likely to study biology than physics.
words.ex_cn: 女性更有可能学习生物而不是物理。
words.en: Females are individuals of the sex that can bear offspring or produce eggs, distinguished biologically by the production of gametes (ova) that can be fertilized by male gametes.

words.tr:
n. 信号；
v. 用信号通知；
words.ex: The traffic light is a signal to stop.
words.ex_cn: 交通灯是一个停止的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.tr:
n. 结束；尽头；目标；末端；
v. 结束；终止；
words.ex: The end of the movie made everyone cry.
words.ex_cn: 电影的结尾让所有人都哭了。
words.en: The end of something such as a period of time, an event, a book, or a film is the last part of it or the point at which it stops.

words.ex: He showed strong emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，表现出了强烈的情绪。
words.en: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.ex: He felt great pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到极大的痛苦。
words.en: Pain is the feeling of great discomfort you have, for example when you have been hurt or when you are ill.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.ex: She eats fruits to get vitamins.
words.ex_cn: 她吃水果来获取维生素。
words.en: Vitamins are substances that are found in foods and are necessary for normal growth and health.

words.ex: The rivers flow into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入大海。
words.en: Rivers are large natural streams of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.ex: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗菌素治疗感染。
words.en: A substance that can kill or inhibit the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms.

words.ex: Many cities have busy streets and tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 许多城市都有繁忙的街道和高楼。
words.en: A city is a large town.

words.ex: The doctor treated his disease with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生用药物治疗了他的疾病。
words.en: A disease is an illness that affects people, animals, or plants, often caused by infection or a failure of health rather than by an accident.

words.tr: n. 清洁；打扫； v. 打扫；“clean”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cleaning of the room took an hour.
words.ex_cn: 打扫房间花了一个小时。
words.en: The act of making something clean, especially the inside of a house or building.

words.ex: He works in marketing for a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家科技公司从事营销工作。
words.en: Marketing involves the process of promoting, selling, and distributing a product or service. It includes market research and advertising.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.ex: He walks in the forest every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在森林里散步。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.ex: The market sells fresh meat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市场每天早上卖新鲜肉类。
words.en: Fresh meat refers to meat that has not been preserved by smoking, curing, or freezing and is therefore considered to be in its natural state. It can also metaphorically refer to someone who is new to a particular activity or environment.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A king is a man who is the most important member of the royal family of his country, and who is considered to be the head of state of that country.

words.ex: He drinks beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝啤酒。
words.en: Beer is an alcoholic drink made from grain.

words.ex: The camels walk across the hot deserts.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越炎热的沙漠。
words.en: Deserts refer to what someone deserves, especially in terms of reward or punishment.

words.tr: v. 集中；浓缩；“concentrate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 浓缩的；密集的；全神贯注的；
words.ex: He concentrated on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他专心做作业。
words.en: If something is concentrated, it has been made stronger or purer by removing or reducing the amount of other substances in it.

words.tr: n. 航运；船运；运输； v. 装运；“ship”的现在分词；
words.ex: The shipping industry moves goods across oceans.
words.ex_cn: 航运业将货物运过海洋。
words.en: The act of sending goods from one place to another, especially by ship.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.tr:
n. 连接物；
v. 连接；联系；
words.ex: The chain has a broken link.
words.ex_cn: 这条链子有一个断了的连接物。
words.en: A link between two people, organizations, or places is a connection between them.

words.ex: He likes math because it is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它很简单。
words.en: Math is the study of numbers, quantities, and shapes.

words.ex: The children played with the recorders in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在教室里玩录像机。
words.en: Recorders are devices used to capture sound or data for playback or analysis.

words.ex: Children enjoy outdoor activities after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢放学后参加户外活动。
words.en: Activities are things that people do in order to achieve a particular result or to have fun.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: He washed his hands to remove the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他洗手以去除污垢。
words.en: Dirt is any substance that makes something unclean, such as mud or dust.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.tr:
n. 蜡；
v. 给…上蜡；
words.ex: Bees make wax to build their hives.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢。
words.en: Wax is a solid, slightly shiny substance made of fat or oil that is used to make candles, polish, and other products. It can also refer to the process of applying wax to something or the natural substance found in the ear.

words.tr: n. 显微镜( microscope的名词复数 )
words.ex: The students look at cells through microscopes.
words.ex_cn: 学生们通过显微镜观察细胞。
words.en: An optical instrument used for viewing very small objects, such as mineral samples or animal or plant cells, typically magnified several hundred times.

words.ex: She wore a dress made of cotton.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件棉质裙子。
words.en: Cotton is a plant that produces a soft fiber which is used to make cloth or thread. Cotton is also the cloth or thread that is made from this fiber.

words.ex: Dogs produce saliva when they smell food.
words.ex_cn: 狗闻到食物时会分泌唾液。
words.en: Saliva is the watery liquid that forms in your mouth and helps you to chew and digest food.

words.ex: The homes are small but cozy.
words.ex_cn: 这些房子虽小但很温馨。
words.en: Homes refers to the places where people live, including houses, apartments, or other types of dwellings. It can also refer to a person's place of origin or where they feel they belong.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.ex: The boiler heats water for the house.
words.ex_cn: 锅炉为房子加热水。
words.en: A boiler is a device that heats water or produces steam.

words.ex: The air is clean after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气很清新。
words.en: Air is the invisible gaseous substance surrounding the earth, a mixture mainly of oxygen and nitrogen.

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.ex: The radiators in the room keep it warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的暖气片在冬天让房间保持温暖。
words.en: Radiators are devices that send out heat, often used to warm rooms or to cool engines by dissipating heat.

words.ex: This is a simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一道简单的数学题。
words.en: If you describe something as simple, you mean that it is not complicated, and is therefore easy to understand.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.ex: There are differences between the two phones.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机之间有差异。
words.en: Differences refer to the ways in which people or things are not the same as each other.

words.ex: The repetition of the same words made the lesson boring.
words.ex_cn: 相同词语的重复让这堂课变得无聊。
words.en: The act of repeating something that has already been said or written.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.tr: adj. 疲倦的；厌烦的； v. “tire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt tired after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一个小时后感到疲倦。
words.en: If you are tired, you feel that you want to rest or sleep.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.ex: He watches a movie every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上都看电影。
words.en: A movie is a story or event recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a cinema or on television.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: We arrived at the airport early.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早到达了机场。
words.en: An airport is a place where aircraft regularly take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in.

words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.ex: The monkeys are climbing the trees.
words.ex_cn: 猴子们正在爬树。
words.en: Monkeys are mammals of the order Primates, which includes lemurs, lorises, tarsiers, and apes, including humans. They are known for their intelligence and social behavior.

words.ex: The factory releases chemicals into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂将化学药品排入河中。
words.en: Chemicals are substances that are used in or produced by a chemical process.

words.ex: I eat two oranges every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上吃两个橙子。
words.en: Oranges are round, orange-colored fruits that grow on a tree and are commonly eaten for their juicy flesh and high vitamin C content.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.ex: The painter used vivid colors to show the forest.
words.ex_cn: 画家用鲜艳的颜色来描绘森林。
words.en: If you describe memories and descriptions as vivid, you mean that they are very clear and detailed.

words.ex: He remembers his childhood as a happy time.
words.ex_cn: 他记得自己的童年是一段快乐的时光。
words.en: Childhood is the period of a person's life when they are a child.

words.ex: He felt sad when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到伤心。
words.en: Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.

words.ex: She adds spices to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她给汤里加香料。
words.en: Spices are substances obtained from plants, which are used to flavor food or drink.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Our team won the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 我们的团队赢得了足球比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.ex: The company must follow the safety regulations.
words.ex_cn: 公司必须遵守安全条例。
words.en: Regulations are rules or laws designed to control the way that something happens or is done.

words.tr:
n. 害怕；惧怕；
v. 害怕；惧怕；
words.ex: He felt a deep fear when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，感到深深的害怕。
words.en: An unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.ex: She bought a new perfume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一瓶新香水。
words.en: A perfume is a pleasant-smelling liquid which people put on their skin to make themselves smell nice.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
